description.en: Decision tracking across issues: runs, decisions, and outcomes become a typed causal graph (native task hooks + Semantica decision mirrors + Pythia hypothesis closure + LLM-curated proposals behind a human-confirm gate). Adds the /experimental/causal-graph surface. Off by default.
description.zh: 跨 issue 的决策追踪:运行、决策与结果汇成类型化因果图(原生任务钩子 + Semantica 决策镜像 + Pythia 假设闭环 + 人工确认门控的 LLM 提议)。新增 /experimental/causal-graph 页面。默认关闭。
